questions: Is a route the same in both directions, so Circle to Madina and Madina to Circle always cost the same, or should each direction have its own fare?
If a passenger asks about two stops with no direct route between them, should the system say no route was found, or work out a trip that combines routes and add up the fares?
Should only station staff be allowed to add routes and change fares (for example with a password), while passengers can only look up fares?
answers: Yes. Circle to Madina costs the same as Madina to Circle, so we keep one route for both directions and passengers can ask either way.
Say it was not found. Do not try to join two routes together; only direct routes count.
